notes.title: 关于这款游戏
notes.content:
关于这款拼图游戏呢。有几点需要跟玩家们说明一下
1.游戏时按Q.E或者空格可以旋转拼图！！！
2.目前游戏的玩法和体系大概就是这样了，不会再进行大的修改。当然如果大家有什么关于游戏的BUG或者意见也可以直接在社区里面留言。每一条留言我都会认真的看，并且及时修改这些BUG和意见。
3.如果觉得游戏比较贵，可以先加购物车， 到steam活动的时候再买，我也会在每次活动的时候打折。
4.碍于个人精力和时间有限，这款游戏的更新时间可能会比较慢，但我会一直更新下去，这点大家不必担心！


最后真的很感谢大家对这款游戏的支持，我也会一直维护下去。谢谢ːsteamfacepalmː
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
About this jigsaw puzzle. There are a few points that need to be explained to the players.
1. Press Q.E or space to rotate the puzzle during the game! ! !
2. The gameplay and system of the current game is probably like this, and no major changes will be made. Of course, if you have any bugs or opinions about the game, you can leave a message directly in the community. I will take a serious look at each message and modify these bugs and opinions in time.
3. If you think the game is more expensive, you can add a shopping cart first, and then buy it when you are in the steam event. I will also discount at each event.
4. Due to personal energy and limited time, the update time of this game may be slower, but I will keep updating, so don't worry!


Finally, I really appreciate everyone's support for this game, I will continue to maintain it. Thank youːsteamfacepalmː

tags.bug: I will take a serious look at each message and modify these bugs and opinions in time.

notes.title: version 1.1.11 update
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.11 update[/b]
1. Re-adjust the unlocking style and the number of PPs in the puzzle
   (The number required is reduced, so everyone can happily unlock all kinds of puzzles)
2. Re-adjust the number of PPs that complete the puzzle reward
    (Complete a puzzle to get PP=level X2)
3. Customize the puzzle when the puzzle selection box is better
4. Adjust the expression of the mascot, now it is more happy
---------------------------------------------------------
[b]版本1.1.11更新[/b]
1.重新调整解锁样式和拼图的PP数量
  （所需数量都减少了，这样大家就可以愉快的解锁各类拼图）
2.重新调整完成拼图奖励的PP数量
   （完成一幅拼图获得PP=等级X2）
3.自定义拼图时的拼图选择框更加好看了
4.调整吉祥物的表情，现在它变得更高兴了
